text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-4821 triggered: high 5xx rate and inference timeouts on prod inference cluster. Page fired to schedule 'infra_oncall' (maya). Severity: P1.

pagerduty: Alert routed to maya (oncall). No ack within 2m; escalation will target alan (secondary) per policy.

tom SRE: watching this thread, have context on recent rolling deploys?

maya (oncall): sorry, just pulled in my phone — ACK. I'm looking at gateway logs and runtime hosts now.

maya (oncall): quick check: 5xxs hit spike starting ~08:12 UTC, CPU on redwood-runtime nodes stable but GPU mem pressure high on a few hosts. running logs grep:

```
kubectl -n inference logs -l app=redwood-runtime --tail=200 | grep "ERROR" | head -n 50
# seeing repeated KV cache miss + timeout lines from host g2-12-03
```

pagerduty: Escalation: primary did not ack within escalation window earlier; manager page fired to 'sre-manager' as part of PD policy.

sre-manager: I'm awake and watching. Keep me posted on customer impact and mitigation steps.

alan (secondary): ACK. I'm joining to look at autoscaler and pod restart history. I already see multiple OOMKilled on node g2-12-03; kubelet shows restarts.

maya (oncall): also noticing a traffic cluster from customer shard cust-129, many long-context requests causing huge KV cache misses. Could be combined cause (traffic shape + bad image that increased mem usage).

tom SRE: FYI there was a canary image rolled yesterday with tag rwd-runtime:2026-03-09-b that increased memory footprint in staging. Not yet rolled back to prod.

alan (secondary): mitigation plan: scale inference-deployment -> 10 replicas (temp), enable fallback routing to smaller model rwd-sm-1b for high-token requests, and throttle max_concurrency to limit per-pod mem. Applying now.

alan (secondary): executing scale: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy inference-runtime --replicas=10`

incident-bot: Change executed by alan (secondary): scaled inference-runtime to 10 replicas at 08:25 UTC.

maya (oncall): after scale and fallback routing, 5xxs dropped from ~6.8% to 0.6% over 3 mins, p50 latency back to normal (~120ms). Monitoring windows show improvement.

sre-manager: Good. Keep incident open for 15m of stable telemetry. If image is root cause, we'll plan a revert and postmortem. Notify product if cust-129 saw degraded SLA.

alan (secondary): creating a short runbook note and will open a follow-up ticket: "PD-4821 followup - investigate image rwd-runtime:2026-03-09-b and autoscaler settings".

maya (oncall): tagging the customer-impact: cust-129 saw ~45min elevated latency/5xxs during spike window; CS will notify them if needed.

tom SRE: also adding note to alerts: consider adding a token-length-based routing rule to drop or route extremely long requests to lower-cost model to avoid amplifying mem pressure.

maya (oncall): handing off to day SRE at 09:00 UTC for post-incident follow-up and RCA. I'll close the immediate page but keeping the channel open for followup actions.

incident-bot: PD-4821 status updated: mitigated and monitoring. Incident will transition to followup after stability window.

pagerduty: Incident PD-4821 resolved: no active pages. Record follow-up ticket and assign owners.

maya (oncall): thanks everyone. I'll drop a quick summary and link the followup ticket in this thread. :thumbsup:
